entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="おじいちゃんが書いた俳句をタトゥーに？ どこに入れるの？" t="A haiku from your grandpa? Where d'you want it inked?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="おじいちゃんが書いた俳句をタトゥーに？ どこに入れるの？" t="Un haiku de la bunicu’? Unde vrei să ți-l tatuezi?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="まあ、まずは聞けよ… 「眠る蛇 頭をあげれば 雫したたる」" t="Listen to this – \"A sleeping giant, a surge of glory, a dewdrop strokes the firm grain.\" " b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="まあ、まずは聞けよ… 「眠る蛇 頭をあげれば 雫したたる」" t="Ascultă asta – „Șarpe adormit, ridică capul și picură roua.”" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="もっと短くできなかったの？ 入れる場所がないと思うけど…" t="Pop-pop couldn't write anything shorter? Dunno if you even got space..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="もっと短くできなかったの？ 入れる場所がないと思うけど…" t="Bunicu’ n-a putut scrie ceva mai scurt? Nu știu dacă mai ai loc..." b="" a=""/>
